text: {"lessons":["Selling after a gain feels satisfying, but a stock’s short-term gain alone is not a reason to sell; consider its outlook and my overall plan.","I made several sales early, so I should avoid trading just to lock in small gains and remember that holding is also a valid choice.","My account value moved up and down despite those sales; judge decisions over time and keep enough cash and diversification rather than focusing only on each realized gain."]}
